answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to lock capital to validate transactions. In this ivory tower of digital security, an attacker cannot simply build an island of fake identities to sway consensus, as each node requires a tangible financial sacrifice. Much like the resilient juniper tree surviving harsh terrain, this model forces adversaries to incur high opportunity costs for every additional identity, rendering mass replication prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
